finding.rationale: Site enumeration via GET /sites?search=* maps every SharePoint Online site collection and its external-sharing posture (sharingCapability), giving an adversary a ranked target list of repositories to collect from — especially those with external sharing enabled. A Conditional Access policy requiring a compliant/managed app or device for SharePoint Online blocks the borrowed first-party FOCI client (14d82eec) running on an unmanaged host from reaching site data, cutting the technique off at the authorization boundary. Recommended-but-not-yet-observed: Tool 14 shipped after the last committed run, so no replay-log sample exercises it yet.
